description: Update the fields (content, target profiles, schedule date/time) of an existing post. To move a post to a different slot without touching anything else, use reschedule_post.

content.description: Updated text body of the post.

id.description: The Database ObjectId of the post to update.

platforms.description: Replacement platform list; each platform expands to all of its connected profiles.

scheduleDate.description: Updated schedule date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

scheduleTime.description: Updated schedule time in HH:MM format.

targetAccounts.description: Replacement profile list, each with platform and profileId. Supplying this re-points the post at exactly these profiles.

content.description: Copy for this profile only, overriding the shared content. Use it to write natively for each platform - a 280-character post for X, a longer one for LinkedIn.

mediaUrl.description: Media for this profile only, overriding the shared mediaUrl.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the schedule above is expressed in, e.g. "Asia/Kolkata". Defaults to UTC on the server, so pass the user's own zone whenever a wall-clock time matters.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (project) id to act on, from list_workspaces. Omit to use the caller's default workspace. Always pass this when the user belongs to more than one workspace.

name: update_post
